title: Stand in Awe of God

questions.question: Guard your steps when you go to the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:1 (ESV): "Guard your steps when you go to the house of God."

questions.question: To draw near to listen is better than to offer the sacrifice of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:1 (ESV): "To draw near to listen is better than to offer the sacrifice of fools,"

questions.question: For God is in heaven and you are on earth. Therefore let your words be what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:2 (ESV): "Therefore let your words be few."

questions.question: When you vow a vow to God, do not delay doing what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:4 (ESV): "When you vow a vow to God, do not delay paying it,"

questions.question: He who loves money will not be satisfied with what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:10 (ESV): "He who loves money will not be satisfied with money,"

questions.question: A dream comes with much business, and a fool's voice with many what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:3 (ESV): "and a fool's voice with many words."

questions.question: It is better that you should not vow than that you should vow and not do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:5 (ESV): "It is better that you should not vow than that you should vow and not pay."

questions.question: If you see in a province the oppression of the poor and the violation of justice and righteousness, do not be what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:8 (ESV): "do not be amazed at the matter,"

questions.question: Sweet is the sleep of a laborer, whether he eats little or much, but the full stomach of the rich will not let him do what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:12 (ESV): "but the full stomach of the rich will not let him sleep."

questions.question: As he came from his mother's womb he shall go again, naked as he came, and shall take nothing for his what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:15 (ESV): "and shall take nothing for his toil that he may carry away in his hand."

questions.question: Let not your mouth lead you into what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:6 (ESV): "Let not your mouth lead you into sin,"

questions.question: Why should God be angry at your voice and destroy the work of your what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:6 (ESV): "and destroy the work of your hands?"

questions.question: For when dreams increase and words grow many, there is vanity; but God is the one you must what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:7 (ESV): "but God is the one you must fear."

questions.question: Everyone also to whom God has given wealth and possessions and power to enjoy them... this is the gift of whom?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:19 (ESV): "this is the gift of God."

questions.question: For he will not much remember the days of his life because God keeps him occupied with what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 5:20 (ESV): "because God keeps him occupied with joy in his heart."

key_verse_text: Be not rash with your mouth, nor let your heart be hasty to utter a word before God, for God is in heaven and you are on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
